  "memo":"R03 alone holds: the card was issued in IN, the IP is US, and AVS failed. Card is the sole adverse family; all other rule conditions are unmet. No household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. FP-2 §6.6(b) applies, but the required id_check passed, so §5.3(a) mandates clear and prohibits further adverse dispositions. Legitimate use of a foreign-issued card is more plausible than stolen-card use after verification. No contact check is required, and no further check would change the policy decision."
